intro: Hi, I'm VERUS! This is me, running on a demonstration company: two manufacturers, three plants. The data is made up. The software is real.
01-sign-in: I run inside your network, and I only read. I never change a thing in your systems.
02-brief: Every morning, the plant manager gets a brief from me: what changed yesterday, and what needs a decision.
02b-show-me: Press Show me on any line, and I light up the numbers behind it.
03-finding: Each problem names the customer and the number: on-time delivery at seventy-five percent, against an eighty-five percent limit.
04-plan: I propose a plan, with the steps, who owns them, and the date it gets judged.
05-dashboard: Yesterday's numbers by line and department, with a caution wherever the data can't be trusted.
05b-verus-tour: New to a screen? Click me, and I'll show you around.
06-ask: Ask me a question in plain words. I'll answer, and show you exactly how I worked it out.
07a-sentence: Need something watched? Describe an agent in one sentence.
07b-agent: I read it back in plain words. Nothing runs until you switch it on.
08-backtest: First, I show you what the agent would have caught last year: here, the scrap spike on H B zero three in March.
09-documents: Your own documents answer too, with the page each answer came from.
10-owner: The owner sees every company side by side, on one set of definitions.
11-quiet: And hears from me when a key customer goes quiet: no contact in a hundred and seven days.
outro: I'm VERUS. See me on your own data, read-only, inside your network.
